problem:
The number of subscribers $S(t)$ to a video channel after $t$ weeks can be modeled by the differential equation

$$
\frac{\text{d}S}{\text{d}t}=0.05S.
$$

If the channel currently has $15\,000$ subscribers, calculate the number of subscribers after $12$ weeks. Round your answer to the nearest integer.

feedback.problem:
The number of cells in a petri dish $C(t)$ after $t$ hours can be modeled by the differential equation

$$
\frac{\text{d}C}{\text{d}t}=C.
$$

If there are currently $650$ cells in the petri dish, calculate the number of cells after $2$ hours. Round your answer to the nearest integer.

The number of cells after $2$ hours is approximately 
{{field-1}}
cells.
feedback.worked_solution:
We model the number of cells using the differential equation

$$
\frac{\text{d}C}{\text{d}t}=C.
$$

The solution to this equation is

$$
C(t)={C}_{0}\,{e}^{t},
$$

where ${C}_{0}$ is the initial value.

We're told that there are currently $650$ cells in the petri dish, so we have ${C}_{0}=650.$

Therefore, the number of cells $C$ at time $t$ is

$$
C(t)=650\,{e}^{t}.
$$

Finally, to find the number of cells when $t=2,$ we substitute $t=2$ into the above, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}C(2) & =650\,{e}^{2} \\  & ≈4802.89\end{aligned}
$$

Rounding our answer to the nearest integer, we conclude that the number of cells after $2$ hours is approximately $4803$ cells.
